text:
maria: Quick heads-up — TechCrunch says they spotted our kit and asked to lift embargo 2h early. Need rapid ops call.

ev an: Who authorized early access?

maria: No one. Looks like a provisional PDF landed in the public S3 by mistake. @nora can you confirm and remove?

nora: Confirmed. An older file named "bench-provisional.pdf" was copied by an automated job. Removing now and checking ACLs.

drew: Legal note: do not engage on any performance numbers publicly. We'll prepare a neutral clarification line in case press publishes early.

maria: PR ops plan: 1) remove asset 2) DM TechCrunch contact with corrected link + apology 3) prepare a clarification tweet ready to post if needed. OK?
ev an: Draft DM to reporter: "Apologies — an earlier provisional asset was published in error. Please reference our official press kit here: <press-kit-link>. Final benchmark numbers will be published at 09:00 PT."

kate: Exec one-liner in case of escalation: "We regret the premature release of provisional materials; final benchmarks will be published at 09:00 PT."

drew: Legal approves that wording. Also include: "Published figures are representative of specific workloads; see bench-method README for details."

press-bot: Removed file "bench-provisional.pdf" from public S3 at 2025-11-12T06:22:10Z.

deploy-bot: Created task "Confirm no other provisional assets live" assigned to nora, due 2025-11-12T09:00:00Z.
ev an: DM sent to TechCrunch contact. Reporter replied: "Thanks — updated link; we'll hold coverage until your 09:00 PT release."

maria: Great. PR will stage clarification tweet but not post. If anything changes, ping here immediately. :white_check_mark:
